description: This file implements cryptographic random number generation functions, including seeding and generating random values of various sizes, with fallbacks for different platforms and optional OpenSSL support.

methods.name: Reseed
methods.description: Seeds the random number generator, using platform-specific methods and OpenSSL's RAND_poll if available.

methods.name: Random
methods.description: Overloaded functions to generate random values of types uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, and uint64_t, with fallbacks if OpenSSL's RAND_bytes fails.
